atomic: The retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall be subjected to visual inspection of general specifications and of shapes and dimensions (Annex 5) on all samples a to j.

The retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6), followed by colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, as specified in Table 4.
